subtitle: "BIO253 HS2026 · Topic 1 · S. aureus JE2"
format: html
---

## 1. Research question

Does *S. aureus* JE2 show significant phosphorylation changes after 15 minutes of *P. aeruginosa* supernatant exposure, and how does this compare with approximately 15 hours of exposure?

This analysis uses the course-provided differential expression results to allow a more consistent comparison with the total-proteomics analysis.

## 2. Setup and data

```{r}
#| label: setup

source("../../R/setup.R")

dea_phospho <- read_dea("phospho_STYH")

dplyr::glimpse(dea_phospho)
```

## 3. Explore the prepared DEA results

We first examine the two estimate types in the course-provided
phosphoproteomics DEA. The `observed` results and the
`lod_imputed` results will be evaluated separately.

```{r}
#| label: estimate-types

dea_phospho |>
  dplyr::filter(
    contrast %in% c(
      "TSB_vs_SNpulse_at_anc",
      "TSB_vs_SN_at_anc"
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::count(contrast, estimate_type)
```

## 4. Significant phosphosites in the prepared DEA

We define a significant change as FDR < 0.05 and an absolute
log2 fold change greater than 1, matching the thresholds used
in the total-proteomics analysis.

The observed and imputed estimates are summarised separately.

```{r}
#| label: significant-sites

phospho_summary <- dea_phospho |>
  dplyr::filter(
    contrast %in% c(
      "TSB_vs_SNpulse_at_anc",
      "TSB_vs_SN_at_anc"
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    changed = !is.na(FDR) &
              !is.na(diff) &
              FDR < 0.05 &
              abs(diff) > 1
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(contrast, estimate_type) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    sites_tested = dplyr::n(),
    significant_sites = sum(changed),
    percent_significant = round(
      100 * significant_sites / sites_tested, 2
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

phospho_summary
```

## 5. Replicate reliability of observed phosphosites

To make the analysis more comparable with the total-proteomics
analysis, we require phosphosites to be detected in at least
2 of 3 biological replicates in both compared conditions.

```{r}
#| label: observed-reliability

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

sites_raw <- read_sites("STYH")

# Count observed replicates for each phosphosite and medium
n_obs_phospho <- sites_raw |>
  filter(genotype == "anc") |>
  group_by(site_id, medium) |>
  summarise(
    n = sum(!is.na(log2_intensity)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = medium,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  )

# Join replicate counts to the observed DEA results
dea_observed <- dea_phospho |>
  filter(
    estimate_type == "observed",
    contrast %in% c(
      "TSB_vs_SNpulse_at_anc",
      "TSB_vs_SN_at_anc"
    )
  ) |>
  left_join(n_obs_phospho, by = "site_id") |>
  mutate(
    reliable = case_when(
      contrast == "TSB_vs_SNpulse_at_anc" ~
        TSB >= 2 & SNpulse >= 2,
      contrast == "TSB_vs_SN_at_anc" ~
        TSB >= 2 & SN >= 2
    ),
    changed = !is.na(FDR) &
              !is.na(diff) &
              FDR < 0.05 &
              abs(diff) > 1
  )

# Summarise only reliably measured phosphosites
observed_reliable_summary <- dea_observed |>
  filter(reliable %in% TRUE) |>
  group_by(contrast) |>
  summarise(
    sites_tested = n(),
    significant_sites = sum(changed),
    percent_significant = round(
      100 * significant_sites / sites_tested, 2
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

observed_reliable_summary
```
